player_prompt.intro:
Yaa Player {player_id} kɛɛrɛ Reverse Tic Tac Toe kɛɛlɛ la. A yɛrɛ sɛmboolo '{symbol}'.
Kɛɛlɛ la pɔɔrɔ yaa sɛɛrɛ tɔɔ tɔɔɔri (kɔɔrɔ, wɛɛrɛ, wɔɔlɛ).
Yaa sɛɛrɛ tɔɔ tɔɔɔri, yaa LOSE.
Kɔɔlɛ a yɛrɛ sɛmboolo kɛɛlɛ '[4]' nɛɛ a yɛrɛ sɛmboolo kɛɛlɛ cell 4.
Kɔɔmaa Player {player_id}, yaa '{symbol}' nɛɛ a yɛrɛ sɛmboolo kɛɛlɛ '{opponent_symbol}'.
